statement: You receive one line holding a string of the six bracket characters ( ) [ ] { }. Print yes when the string is balanced - every opener is closed by the matching closer in the correct nesting order - and no otherwise. Use a stack: push every opener; on a closer, the stack must be non-empty and its top must be the matching opener, which is then popped. After the scan the stack must be empty.
constraints: Only the six bracket characters appear.

example.why: Each closer meets its own opener at the top: } closes {, ] closes [, ) closes (.

hint: Two failure doors: a closer on an empty stack, and leftovers on the stack at the end.
mistake: Counting openers against closers; the counts of ([)] match although the nesting is broken.
